title: Trump to Nominate Heidi Overton, a Top Domestic Policy Aide, for F.D.A. Commissioner
summary: Dr. Overton is a fierce opponent of abortion rights and a supporter of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s Make America Healthy Again agenda.
